item.title: 多瑙河水位下降得如此之低，以至于二战时期的船只正在出现
item.description:
塞尔维亚普拉霍沃（美联社）——欧洲第二长河多瑙河的水位因干旱而下降得如此之低，以至于数十艘二战德国战舰的残骸浮现在视野中。
它们是夏季炎热危机中令人好奇的消遣。多瑙河创纪录的低水位也迫使发电厂濒临关闭，中欧和东欧各国政府正在采取措施节约电力。
在塞尔维亚普拉霍沃港附近分隔塞尔维亚和罗马尼亚的河流中央，现在可以看到生锈的船体以及曾经悬挂纳粹旗帜的破损桅杆。
这些船只，其中一些仍然装载着武器，属于纳粹德国的黑海舰队，在战争接近尾声时，德国人在从罗马尼亚撤退以及苏联军队深入欧洲时故意击沉了这支舰队。
历史学家称，1944 年 9 月，多达 200 艘德国军舰在多瑙河峡谷普拉霍沃附近遭到苏联炮火击沉。故意沉没的目的是减缓苏联在巴尔干地区的前进速度。但几个月后，也就是 1945 年 5 月，纳粹德国投降了。
这些旧军舰的景象提醒人们，塞尔维亚政府在欧盟的财政支持下，长期以来一直在试图对此采取行动。其中一些被南斯拉夫共产主义当局从河中移走，但大多数由于携带炸药而留下来。
然而，现在，由于水位下降造成危险，当局正在努力保持流经 10 个国家的多瑙河的交通畅通。专家将异常炎热的天气与全球变暖和其他因素联系起来。
普拉霍沃居民克里斯塔·布兰迪奇(Krsta Brandic)表示，低水位几乎导致船舶交通停止：“正如你所看到的，(大)船只无法再通过。”
美联社撰稿人杜桑·斯托扬诺维奇 (Dusan Stojanovic) 来自塞尔维亚贝尔格莱德。

item.title: 富埃戈火山喷出火山灰和泥土，迫使危地马拉近2000人躲进避难所
item.description:
危地马拉城（美联社）——中美洲最活跃的火山之一富埃戈火山喷发期间，危地马拉在疏散村庄后，周二仍保持戒备状态。
据该国救灾机构 CONRED 称，大约 1,700 人仍留在避难所，疏散人员将留在原地，直到情况好转。
官员们将萨卡特佩克斯、埃斯昆特拉和奇马尔特南戈的警报级别提升为红色，这些地区约有 29,000 人受到火山灰影响，学校仍然关闭。当局警告称，周二接下来的 72 小时至关重要，长达 7 公里（4.3 英里）的泥石流将继续从火山上冲下，预计降雨将增加出现更多火山泥石流的风险。
泥石流尚未到达村庄，也没有建筑物受损或面临风险的报告。CONRED 执行秘书克劳丁·奥加德斯 (Claudinne Ogaldes) 建议这三个城市的居民遮盖积水，并使用口罩来抵御火山灰。
火山喷发于周一早上开始，随着熔岩和火山碎屑流从山坡上滚下，气体和火山灰云在火山上方升起。周二排放出更多泥浆和灰烬。
疏散人员中约有 250 人来自埃尔波韦尼尔 (El Porvenir) 和拉斯拉吉塔斯 (Las Lajitas) 村庄。CONRED 还警告说，火山灰会蔓延到附近的城镇。
穿过火山附近的一条主要高速公路——14号国道——已被关闭。教育部暂停了附近城镇的课程。
在 2018 年 6 月的前一次富埃戈火山喷发中，数百人丧生，整个村庄被毁。去年的另一次喷发引发了预防性疏散。

item.title: 伊朗和阿曼正在制定重新开放霍尔木兹海峡和其他中东事态发展的计划
item.description:
CAIRO (AP) — Iran and Oman are inching toward a deal to reopen the disputedStrait of Hormuzand potentially help bring anend to the war.
Theemerging agreementcalls for ships to enter the Persian Gulf through an Iranian-controlled route and exit through a route controlled by Oman, two regional officials told The Associated Press.
Any deal, though, appears contingent on the United States lifting its blockade on Iran’s ports. The Trump administration haspreviously ruled out any dealthat would give Iran control over the strait.
Elsewhere, amass funeral was held in Gaza Cityfor more than 100 Palestinians killed in an Israeli strike early in the conflict between Israel and Hamas.
A memorial service was also held in Beirut, for victims of a 2020 port explosion, and Yemen’s Houthis claimed they fired at a Saudi Arabian airport.
Here is a look at the most important developments in the Middle East on Tuesday:
AP correspondent Charles de Ledesma reports a cargo ship has likely been struck in Strait of Hormuz as U.S., and Iran claims about talks diverge.
Senior U.S. officials struck an optimistic tone Tuesday, suggesting a deal to reopen the strait could be reached soon.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio confirmed there has been progress made in talks between Iran and Oman, “but not finality yet.”
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessenttold CNBCthat “there is a chance we may have a deal today or tomorrow to open the strait and move towards a more normalized position in this conflict.”
The Strait of Hormuz is the crucial waterway at the mouth of the Persian Gulf through which a fifth of the world’s traded oil and natural gas passed before the war. It has been effectively shut by Iran’s attacks on shipping since the start of the war in February.
Qatar’s emir, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, said he also spoke to U.S. PresidentDonald Trumpon Tuesday as the Arab country tries to broker a resolution to the war.
Al Thani’s office said in a statement that on the phone call, the two discussed ways to bridge the divide “in a way that enhances the prospects of reaching a sustainable diplomatic settlement to the crisis.”
A cargo ship reported being “hit by an unknown projectile” while traversing the Strait of Hormuz, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations Center.
The center said the reported strike damaged the vessel at around 2 a.m. local time while it was about 37 kilometers (23 miles) northeast of Al Khasab, a port city in Oman.
It’s unclear what flag the ship was sailing under or whether it was carrying cargo, but the British maritime security firm Ambrey said the ship sustained damage.
On the Red Sea, meanwhile, an Indian-flagged commercial ship sank off Yemen after being struck by an explosive-laden boat, Yemeni and Indian authorities said.
Yemen’s coast guard rescued the crew, which included 13 Indians and a Yemeni.
India’s Foreign Ministry condemned the attack, though no one immediately claimed responsibility. Iran-backed Houthi militants have repeatedly struck ships traversing the Red Sea near Yemen.
Hundreds of people gathered Tuesday as bodies wrapped in Palestinian flags were laid in rows near flattened buildings in Gaza City.
The 112 victims were then carried off on stretchers through a narrow street, destined for burial in a nearby cemetery. They were among more than 300 killed during an attack on Nov. 22, 2023, in the city’s Sabra neighborhood.
First responders recovered the bodies, including 40 children and 30 women, over the weekend, according to the Civil Defense, a rescue agency operated under Gaza’s Hamas-run Interior Ministry.
The war in Gaza began on Oct. 7, 2023, when Hamas-led militants attacked southern Israel, killing around 1,200 people and taking 251 hostage.
Israel’s military offensive in Gaza has since killed 73,375 people, including civilians and combatants, according to Gaza’s Health Ministry.
Around 7,400 people are still missing and presumed buried under the rubble from the war, according to Zaher al-Waheidi, head of the Gaza Health Ministry’s records department.
Israeli and Lebanese officials met in Rome on Tuesday to continue talks on implementing a U.S.-mediated deal to draw down the Israeli military from southern Lebanon and disarm the Iran-backed Hezbollah militant group.
A diplomat familiar with the negotiations said Lebanon had asked for the next “pilot zone” — where Israeli forces would withdraw and the Lebanese army would take control — to be either in the town of Khiam or Bint Jbeil. Both areas saw heavy fighting in the latest Israel-Hezbollah war and are currently occupied by Israeli forces.
But U.S. Ambassador to Lebanon Michel Issa suggested ahead of the three-day talks that no new pilot zones would be immediately implemented, saying that “moving too quickly risks jeopardizing the very civilians this process is meant to protect.”
Implementation of the June 26 agreement began last month with an initial pilot zone in an area that wasn’t occupied by Israeli forces but had previously sustained Israeli fire.
In Yemen, Brig. Gen. Yahya Saree, a military spokesperson for the Iranian-backed Houthi rebels, said a drone hit a “sensitive target” at the airport in the southwestern city of Najran, without providing evidence.
He said the attack was in response to what he described as a Saudi breach of Yemen’s airspace over the provinces of Saada and Hajjah. There was no immediate comment from Saudi Arabia.
The Houthis recently announced a blockade on Saudi-linked shipping passing through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait that leads to the Red Sea.
Saudi Arabia led an international coalition and imposed an air and sea blockade against the rebels after they seized the capital, Sanaa, and much of northern Yemen in a civil war that began in 2014. Major fighting ended in a truce in 2022.
Families of the more than 200 people killed in the massive explosion at the port in Beirut in 2020gathered at the blast siteto mark six years since tons of improperly stored ammonium nitrate exploded, devastating large parts of the Lebanese capital.
No one has been convicted in a long-stalled judicial investigation into the incident, but some families expressed renewed hope after government officials promised indictments would be issued by the end of the year.
The tragedy has been overshadowed by recent events, including two wars between Israel and the Hezbollah militant group and an Israeli military occupation of much of the country’s south.
Becatoros reported from Athens, Greece. Wafaa Shurafa in Deir al-Balah, Gaza Strip, Abby Sewell in Beirut, Maria Grazia Murru in Rome, Matthew Lee in Washington and Philip Marcelo in New York contributed to this report.

item.title: 被控纵火斯波坎最大野火的男子因去年另外两起火灾而受到讯问
item.description:
SPOKANE, Wash. (AP) — A man charged with intentionally setting awildfirethat’s destroyed hundreds of buildings in and around Washington state’s second-largest city was questioned by law enforcement during two fire investigations last year, though he wasn’t charged in either, court documents show.
Aaron F. Farinacci, of Spokane, was arrested Monday and booked on suspicion of first-degree arson in connection with the Old Trails Fire, the biggest of three blazes that have destroyed at least 700 buildings andforced tens of thousands of peoplefrom their homes. According to court records, he denied setting the fire. His bond was set at $1 million.
The other two fires burning around Spokane were also started by humans, though not necessarily intentionally, investigators said Tuesday. The exact cause remains under investigation.
No deaths have been reported and cooler, calmer weather aided firefighters again Tuesday. Only one of the three fires — the Autumn Lane fire — grew. But hotter, drier and windier conditions are expected later in the week.
Farinacci, 37, served about a decade in prison afterkilling his fatherin Arizona in 2010. Last year, authorities questioned him in two fire-related cases in Spokane, according to a probable cause statement filed in Spokane County Superior Court.
A Buddha statue is seen with fire damage amongst the rubble of a house burned after a wildfire hit the northern part of Spokane, Wash., Monday, Aug. 3, 2026. (AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson)
One involved several “bus-sized” fires in an area near Farinacci’s apartment in July 2025, police records in that case say. The other involved a wildfire in a state park that prompted evacuation notices the following month. In neither case was he arrested.
At a press briefing, Spokane County, Washington Sheriff John Nowels says they have a suspect in custody.
On Saturday, Paul Child, 64, was driving with his grandson along some railroad tracks in his rural neighborhood northwest of Spokane. He saw a man standing and looking toward nearby trees. About 10 minutes later, as they were returning home, the man was still there.
“He was bent over in the brush, acting nervous,” Child told The Associated Press on Tuesday. “You get the feeling this guy’s up to something.”
“No longer than 10 minutes after I got home, my daughter says, ‘There’s a fire,’” Child recalled. “My first words were, ‘That SOB started a fire!’ It was the exact spot where he was standing.”
Child’s daughter called 911 and he drove back to the spot where he’d seen the man, sheriff’s detective Michael Drapeau wrote in the probable cause statement. He gave a police officer a description of the man he had seen — bald, white, wearing a green shirt and carrying a backpack.
A responding sheriff’s deputy saw a man matching that description walking more than 1 mile (1.6 kilometers) away and detained him. Another deputy also responded, and Child showed up to identify the person in custody — Farinacci — as the one he had seen in the area of the fire, the document states.
Farinacci had a backpack and a fanny pack, in which he had a pack of cigarettes, waterproof matches and a butane lighter, it says. He told the deputies he didn’t start the fire and he denied having been in the area where it started. He was wearing a green T-shirt that read, “who needs luck I have charm,” the detective wrote.
The deputies were unaware of Farinacci’s prior fire-related contacts and the cause of the Old Trails Fire hadn’t been determined yet, so they released him to continue working on evacuation efforts, Drapeau wrote.
But the following day, a wildland fire investigator ruled out other possible causes, including sparks from electric wires or passing trains, and police arrested Farinacci on Monday.
“As it happens in so many critical cases, it was citizens who were paying attention to their surroundings, being aware and willing to step up and say something that led to the relatively quick apprehension of Mr. Farinacci,” Sheriff John Nowels told reporters.
Child credited the heroic work of police and firefighters responding to the disaster, and said he hopes people who lost homes “can get some kind of peace of mind or a little bit of comfort” from the arrest.
Farinacci appeared in court Tuesday via video link from the jail and was represented by Colin Charbonneau, director of the Spokane County public defender’s office. A judge set his arraignment for Thursday.
In an effort to get comment from Farinacci’s family, The Associated Press sent a message to a possible social media account for a brother.
A detective investigating the Old Trails Fire ran a criminal history check on Farinacci and found that he had been contacted by law enforcement twice before during fire investigations.
Spokane police responded to reports of several fires on July 8, 2025, near Farinacci’s apartment. The area near the Spokane River involved several “bus-sized” fires and prompted a significant emergency response, according to a police record.
The Washington State Patrol made contact with Farinacci the following month while pursuing a suspect in a wildfire at Riverside State Park. They found him on a park bench, “seemingly out of breath from possibly running.” They took photos of him. He was wearing a green T-shirt just like the one he was seen wearing on Saturday, the document says.
Farinacci, then age 21,shot and killed his fatherin Mesa, Arizona, during a 2010 argument about washing dishes, police said. Farinacci also shot himself but survived.
He was charged with murder but pleaded guilty in 2012 to manslaughter and aggravated assault, records show.
Miriam Sim, 76, reacts while talking about her neighborhood largely burning to the ground after a wildfire hit the northern part of Spokane, Wash., Monday, Aug. 3, 2026. (AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson)
A judge in 2011 found that Farinacci was mentally fit to assist in his own defense, though defense lawyer Jose Colon continued to raise questions about his mental health and noted that he had been hospitalized multiple times for psychiatric treatment, court records show.
In a letter to the judge, Beth Farinacci, who had married Farinacci’s father, said second-degree murder, not manslaughter, would have been a more appropriate way to resolve the case.
“Manslaughter is for when someone accidentally kills another person. It is not for someone who intentionally points a loaded gun at their father and shoots him in his face and back,” Beth Farinacci wrote.
Farinacci was released from probation in Arizona in early 2024. A probation officer said Farinacci maintained a stable residence with his girlfriend and her family in the previous year, but also noted he hadn’t completed a mental health evaluation or domestic violence treatment.
The fires were among dozens across the Western U.S. that have stretched the ability of federal, state and local agencies to fight them. More than 1,000 firefighters, many from outside of Washington state, were in the Spokane area Tuesday, and that number was expected to rise.
On Monday afternoon, during the hottest part of the day, authorities had to ground all of their firefighting aircraft for nearly two hours due to repeated airspace incursions by privately operated drones, said Tom Stokesberry, spokesperson for the critical incident team managing the fire response.
Federal authorities on Tuesday granted a law enforcement task force the authority to down, by means of electronic disruption, any drones that cross into restricted airspace, he said.
In one neighborhood, blackened vehicles, a boat twisted by the heat and melted plastic recycling bins remained. Across the street, lawns were still green and houses were spared, as residents continued to run hoses or sprinklers to water their properties.
Some residents who had to flee blazes returned to find only chimneys left standing.
“There’s nothing to save,” Miriam Sim, 76, said as she and her husband, Daniel Sim, surveyed the ruins of the home where they had lived since 2005.
Johnson and Bellisle reported from Seattle, and White reported from Detroit. Associated Press reporters Jacques Billeaud in Phoenix; Kathy McCormack in Concord, New Hampshire; and Hallie Golden in Seattle contributed.

item.title: 因特朗普调查而被解雇的联邦调查局特工在针对政府的诉讼中获得广泛支持
item.description:
华盛顿（美联社）——由数千名联邦调查局特工和其他团体组成的协会支持三名联邦调查局雇员提起的诉讼，这三名雇员去年因参与调查唐纳德·特朗普总统试图推翻 2020 年总统选举结果而被解雇。
联邦调查局特工协会提交的一份法律简报是上周外部各方提交的五份支持特工的法律简报之一，这些特工是联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔针对调查特朗普或被认为违背政府利益的员工进行更广泛的人事清洗的一部分而被解雇的。
总而言之，这些文件，包括来自前联邦调查局和司法部校友的文件，突显了两党对过去一年半里困扰联邦调查局的解雇浪潮的一致抵制，因为帕特尔试图按照自己的形象重塑联邦调查局。
简报称，解雇是非法的，因为特工被剥夺了正当程序，并因被认为具有政治倾向而受到惩罚，并表示解雇与数十年来的期望相矛盾，即该局的“非政治性、专业的职业特工队伍”可以在不危及职业生涯的情况下处理敏感案件。
“如果个别特工必须选择是否接受一项可能导致他们被解雇的合法任务，或者拒绝该任务并因不服从而被解雇，那么联邦调查局特工就无法正常运作。联邦调查局特工们早就明白，他们可以根据联邦调查局的需要随时接受任务和重新任务，”这个为近 12,000 名会员提供服务的特工协会在其简报中写道。
司法部前高级官员提交的一份简报称，解雇事件破坏了“半个世纪以来作为指导原则的独立性”。
简报指出，“暂且不考虑由此造成的对原告权利的侵犯，这次‘清洗’的不可避免的影响将是削弱联邦调查局、司法部和其他执法机构剩余和未来的职业代理人、律师、分析师和其他工作人员的独立性，他们现在必须明白，他们的调查和执法判决可以在他们的职业生涯中第一次从党派政治角度进行评估。”
2026 年 7 月 16 日星期四，华盛顿，联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔在唐纳德·特朗普总统在白宫东厅发表讲话之前抵达。（索尔·勒布/泳池，美联社）
这三名特工——米歇尔·鲍尔(Michelle Ball)、杰米·加曼(Jamie Garman)和布莱尔·托尔曼(Blaire Toleman)——在三月份提起的联邦诉讼中表示，他们是在一场针对特朗普调查工作的“报复运动”中被解雇的。诉讼称，这些特工在联邦调查局提供了“模范且无瑕疵”的服务，并预计将在联邦调查局度过余下的职业生涯，但突然被无故解雇，也没有给予回应的机会。
特工们进行的调查最终导致特别检察官杰克·史密斯提出起诉书，指控特朗普密谋推翻他输给民主党人乔·拜登的 2020 年大选。
史密斯最终放弃了该案，以及另一起指控特朗普在 2024 年重新入主白宫后在佛罗里达州棕榈滩海湖庄园非法保留机密记录的案件，并引用了司法部禁止对现任总统提出联邦起诉的法律意见。
帕特尔和时任司法部长的帕姆·邦迪表示，史密斯团队中被解雇的特工和检察官负责将联邦执法武器化，这一说法也在他们的解雇信中得到了证实，但原告称这是诽谤性的且毫无根据的。
这些文件在法律上被称为“法庭之友陈述”。它们有时由诉讼中的外部当事人提交，以帮助强调特定论点或告知法官的想法。
其他提交简报的团体包括第一修正案学者团体、一个名为“法治律师”的团体，以及一个由部门校友组成的网络“司法连接”，该网络在其文件中警告称，“政治化”的联邦调查局可能会因为公民的言论、结社或被认为不忠诚而针对他们。
文件称，“宪法的目的正是为了防止这种滥用行为。”

item.title: 国际足联高级官员温格和格拉夫斯特罗姆与因凡蒂诺的世界杯抛售计划保持距离
item.description:
GENEVA (AP) — Two senior FIFA executives — coaching great Arsène Wenger and CEO-like secretary general Mattias Grafström — distanced themselves Tuesday from their bossGianni Infantino’s failed planto sell stakes in future World Cup profits to private investors.
Wenger said in a statement he knew nothing of the $20 billion plan and that it was “absolutely necessary” to drop the proposal, and Grafström sent an email to all FIFA staff — seen by The Associated Press — calling the last week a “sad and reproachable series of events.” He also said it created “turmoil which is difficult to comprehend and accept.”
Neither directly named Infantino or offered support for the now-embattled president.
Late Tuesday, media reports in Britain said Infantino would hold a crisis meeting with senior FIFA staff in Morocco on Wednesday, which the governing body hadn’t confirmed.
The comments by Wenger and Grafström had echoes of the direct criticism from FIFA chief operating officer Kevin Lamour,who said Fridaythat staff had been “deceived” by Infantino’s private equity plan, which provoked a furor in global soccer. Lamour called it the “project of one person” and said FIFA staff “deserve better than contempt and intimidation.”
The three executives are respected and trusted figures among the 211 FIFA member federations who now hold sway over Infantino’s grip on a presidency that looked unshakeable after the World Cup ended barely two weeks ago.
Wenger, Grafström and Lamour also were named in aletter from UEFA’s lawyers to Infantinoamong 18 executives whose data and communications should be retained as potential evidence.
“You do not need to worry,” Grafström wrote Tuesday to the hundreds of FIFA staff based mostly in Zurich and Coral Gables, Florida. “I assure you that you as members of the administration, you will be defended and safeguarded from the political context we currently experience.”
Wenger, who was hired by Infantino in 2019 and is FIFA’s Chief of Global Football Development, said he was “not involved in this strategic plan and first became aware of the project through media reports.”
Infantino withdrew his $20 billion proposal early Saturday after a furious backlash by global soccer officials, including European body UEFA warning of a boycott of all FIFA games and events.
The plan would have created a subsidiary — known as FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) — to run the money-making parts of the not-for-profit soccer body’s work: organizing tournaments like the World Cup, selling broadcasting and sponsorship rights, tickets and hospitality.
It proposed raising $4.2 billion from investors by selling stakes amounting to about 20% in FFE, based on an equity valuation of $20 billion. The “anchor investor” would have been Thrive Eternal, launched by Joshua Kushner, whose brotherJared Kushneris a son-in-law ofU.S. President Donald Trump.
“The decision to withdraw the project was absolutely necessary and beyond question, because I firmly believe in an independent FIFA that serves our game with commitment, transparency, and integrity,” Wenger wrote.
FIFA’s 211 member federations — already effective owners of the governing body as a nonprofit association under Swiss law — were offered $20 million each. The deadline to accept was Sept. 19.
They also were promised a doubling of their FIFA funding for the four years through 2030 to $20 million instead of the previously announced $10 million.
Infantino shared details of the project to FIFA management just one week after the July 19 final of the financially successful World Cup in North America that drove FIFA’s revenues to $15 billion for the 2023-26 commercial cycle — almost double the income tied to the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.
Grafström, a long-time loyal aide to Infantino since their work together at UEFA, urged FIFA staff to “all continue being proud and happy” about the first 48-team World Cup.
“A sad and reproachable series of events — which were thankfully concluded with the FFE project permanently abandoned — for as much as we feel dismayed by them, should not overshadow this reality,” he wrote.
Infantino came under even more pressure when former FIFA vice presidentPrince Ali bin Al Hussein criticized the soccer body’s leadershipon Tuesday, describing prize money withheld from his Jordan national team as a kind of blackmail.
The World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico was judged a success on the field, though it had unprecedented issues linked to Infantino’s close ally Trump, who received a specially created FIFA Peace Prize at the tournament draw in December.
During the tournament, Iran’s team could not stay in the U.S. where it played three games, a Somali referee picked by FIFA was refused entry, and U.S. forward Folarin Balogun was allowed to play against Belgium despite a red card in his previous game.
“We have all been thrown into the middle of a turmoil, which is difficult to comprehend and accept, but, as secretary general, I urge you to remain focused on what has always united us,” Grafström wrote. “I will continue to support our teams, our work and our mission every hour of every day for as long as my work is valued by those we serve.”
Infantino has not commented in public on the schism in soccer since aFIFA statementearly Saturday announcing that the proposal had been dropped. Hisofficial Instagram accounthas posted letters of support from several member federations, including 2030 World Cup co-host Morocco, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates.
Infantino has been president of FIFA for more than 10 years and had seemed sure to be re-elected unopposed next March in Morocco. FIFA has set a Nov. 18 deadline for challengers to come forward, with Sweden’s soccer leader saying Monday that UEFA is seeking a rival candidate.

item.title: 前国际足联副主席阿里王子称因凡蒂诺领导的足球机构因未支付奖金而“勒索”
item.description:
日内瓦（美联社）——周二，国际足联前副主席阿里·本·侯赛因王子批评了以詹尼·因凡蒂农为首的国际足联领导层，称扣留约旦国家队奖金是一种勒索。
阿里王子表示，他领导的约旦足协去年12月在卡塔尔举行的国际足联阿拉伯杯决赛中仍未收到应得的款项。
阿里王子在社交媒体帖子中表示，在世界杯期间——乔丹在六月份首次亮相——世界杯期间，他被告知如果他支持国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺，“这将大大有助于帮助我们的足协摆脱困境。”
因凡蒂诺向约书亚·库什纳（Joshua Kushner）领导的投资者出售未来世界杯利润股份的计划现已失败，全球足球领导人对此表示强烈反对，因此他面临着挽救其11年主席职位的压力。
“我们为约旦坚持道德价值观而感到自豪。我们以前不支持他，现在也不会，”阿里王子说道。2016 年 2 月因凡蒂诺首次当选时，阿里王子在国际足联五名主席候选人的竞选中名列第三。
“但整个情况相当于勒索，我们拒绝屈服，”这位约旦王室成员周二写道。
据约旦媒体去年报道，2025 年阿拉伯杯决赛中，约旦在与摩洛哥的决赛中失利，该赛事将向落败的决赛选手支付 420 万美元。
阿里王子写道：“我们的球队因进入决赛而应获得的资金尚未交付，而与此同时国际足联则吹嘘他们有多少亿美元的储备。”
“很明显，问题确实在于领导力。几个月来，国际足联一直拒绝在这些或其他问题上帮助我们，”他说。
我们联系国际足联寻求对这些说法的评论。
阿里王子被亚洲足球推选为 2011-15 年度国际足联执政执行委员会成员，并在 2015 年 5 月的选举中与时任主席塞普·布拉特 (Sepp Blatter) 竞争。布拉特连任的投票是在两天前苏黎世酒店突袭逮捕足球官员的阴影下举行的，这是美国和瑞士联邦机构调查的一部分。
因凡蒂诺在世界杯决赛两周后离开纽约时，他似乎已经锁定了无异议连任，第四次也是最后一次领导国际足联直至 2031 年。
一周前曝光的秘密私募股权计划的影响震动了足球政坛，因凡蒂诺在欧洲足球机构欧足联的前同事现在正在寻找竞争对手。如果乔丹和所有其他国际足联成员在 9 月 19 日的截止日期前接受，由库什纳的 Thrive Eternal 基金资助的提案将向乔丹和所有其他国际足联成员每人支付 2000 万美元。
欧足联还威胁要抵制国际足联的比赛、活动和会议，而北美足球组织中北美洲及加勒比海足球协会（CONCACAF）和乔丹所属的亚洲足球联合会的领导层也公开反对因凡蒂诺。
国际足联设定了11月18日为候选人申报参加3月18日在摩洛哥拉巴特举行的211个成员国联合会选举的最后期限。

item.title: 两届普利克尼斯赛冠军骑师罗比·阿尔巴拉多去世，享年 52 岁
item.description:
前骑师罗比·阿尔巴拉多（Robby Albarado）去世，他在漫长的顶级骑术生涯中两次赢得普利克内斯赛（Preakness）。他52岁了。
肯塔基州路易斯维尔丘吉尔唐斯赛道的发言人表示，多名朋友和家人向赛道获悉了阿尔巴拉多的去世消息。据雇用阿尔巴拉多作为健身骑手的教练肯尼·麦克皮克介绍，阿尔巴拉多最近几天住院接受了植入支架手术，以缓解心脏附近的阻塞。
丘吉尔唐斯总裁迈克·安德森在一份声明中表示：“与过早离开我们的人说再见是极其困难的。”“我们向他的家人和众多朋友致以最深切的哀悼。”
阿尔巴拉多最出名的事是在 2007 年骑着“柯林”赢得了普利克内斯和育马者杯经典赛的胜利，他还赢得了 2020 年瑞士跳伞赛 Triple Crownaboard 母马瑞士跳伞赛第二站的冠军。在他职业生涯的 5,222 场比赛中，阿尔巴拉多还获得了另外两次育马者杯冠军。
自 2022 年退休以来，阿尔巴拉多一直为麦克皮克工作，后者训练瑞士跳伞运动员。
阿尔巴拉多出生于路易斯安那州拉斐特，在成为职业选手之前，他开始在丛林赛道骑行，并参加了超过 34,000 场比赛。他的收入刚刚超过 2.21 亿美元。

item.title: AI-driven Ring Cycle sparks boos at 150th anniversary Wagner Festival
item.description:
BAYREUTH, Germany (AP) — Richard Wagner likely would have appreciated the cutting-edge technology, if not the reaction.
Scenery selected by artificial intelligence sparked boos at the 150th anniversary performance of Wagner’s Ring Cycle from an audience frustrated that software could integrate images but not drama.
Called “10010110” — the number 150 in written in binary — the staging is subtitled “From Myth to Code” and was intended to portray the history of “Der Ring des Nibelungen (The Ring of the Nibelung),” a series of four operas about the destruction of gods by humans, giants and dwarfs. It was timed to coincide with the anniversary of the full cycle’s premiere from Aug. 13-17, 1876, at the Festspielhaus theater built to Wagner’s specifications atop a Bavarian hill.
Curator Marcus Lobbes developed the concept with Nils Corte and dramaturge Andri Hardmeier, feeding computers about 1,000 images culled from the 15 prior Bayreuth Ring productions. They did not intend to produce a cohesive drama and suggested minimal blocking.
“We always communicated that it’s an experiment, it’s not stage-directed,” Lobbes said.
Disgruntled by 19th century standards, Wagner demanded his own theater of innovation. Bayreuth’s 239th Ring Cycle was an encyclopedia of interpretations rather than a new one.
Singers stood between two 20-by-60 meter (33-by-66 foot) screens, often not moving, for 14 1/2 hours over four nights. About a dozen AI models were combined and Stable Diffusion was used to start each act with 1876 scenery designed by Gotthold Brückner and Max Brückner from sketches by Josef Hoffmann, then select images based on text and music.
After Saturday night’s concluding “Götterdämmerung,” conductor Christian Thielemann and the cast were greeted with a 17-minute ovation that wrapped around 30 seconds of boos and whistles when the production team joined for their bows.
Many Bayreuth productions are initially jeered, such as Patrice Chéreau’s centennial staging in 1976 that moved the action to the Industrial Revolution, then cheered years later. That production’s final appearance in 1980 ignited a 45-minute ovation.
“I know the ritual,” said Lobbes, director of the Academy for Theatre and Digitality in Dortmund.
He was approached in February 2023 to stage an AI Ring for the sesquicentennial by Katharina Wagner, a great-granddaughter of the composer and current festival director.
Wagner composed the Ring over 26 years. Coders divided it into about 250 scenes of two to six minutes and loaded images from past performances and topical moments to a pair of custom-built Tower PCs with NVIDIA RTX 5090 graphics cards.
Singers led by Michael Volle (Wotan), Camilla Nylund (Brünnhilde) and Klaus Florian Vogt (Siegfried) wore birdlike costumes of wire mesh with black backing and laser voile designed by Pia Maria Mackert, Lobbes’ wife. The outfits shimmered in brilliant colors depending on the lighting, with gold and red most prominent.
As the narrative moved forward, so did AI’s projections.
An image of Theodor Herzl, a key figure in modern Zionism, appeared in “Das Rheingold,” and one of Adolf Hitler in “Die Walküre.” A sign that read: “Sorry, no gas today“ flashed in ”Siegfried” as the timeline reached the 1973 oil crisis and Brünnhilde awakened to sing “Heil dir, Sonne! Heil dir, Licht! (Hail to you, Sun! Hail to you, Light!)”
“Every year of the 150 years, we have an answer from artificial intelligence what she thinks that the audience of Bayreuth would have said is the main political topic of this year or this summer,” Hardmeier said.
Many of the images provoked director name-checking in viewers’ minds — Was this from Wieland Wagner in 1951? From Frank Castorf in 2013? From Valentin Schwarz in 2020?
At other times, AI picked forms that shifted like a giant Etch A Sketch into images evoking works by Mark Rothko and Willem de Kooning.
Original plans for 2026 envisioned performances of the final 10 of Wagner’s 13 operas plus the Festspielhaus debut of the composer’s third, “Rienzi,” until now deemed not worthy of inclusion. The AI Ring was to be presented once to coincide approximately with the original premiere dates, butbudget cuts two years agocaused four operas to be scrapped and replaced by two additional Rings, the first from July 27 to Aug. 1.
Singers were together for just one nine-hour rehearsal over a four-day period in which the directing team worked with cast members in small groups.
“I would wish that with a certain openness people will find some interesting correlations and will see things that maybe others don’t see,” Hardmeier said. “I hope that people go out with a very fruitful irritation — not irritation in the sense of ‘What was this about’ but more sort of, ‘Hey, interesting.’”
Thielemann conducted Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony to open the festival. Wagner led the work at the downtown Margravial Opera House after the Bayreuth cornerstone ceremony in 1872 and it has been repeated on special occasions, such as the 1951 resumption after World War II.
A speech the following day by Michel Friedman titled “Silenced Voices” addressed Wagner’s antisemitism and his family’s support of Hitler and the Nazi party.
A striking staging with Alexandra Szemerédy and Magdolna Parditka, updated to post-modern dystopian times, was greeted with extended applause when it opened on July 26 in the first of nine performances through Aug. 26.
Tenor Andreas Schager gave the title role charisma and vocal beauty, telling the story of 14th century Italian populist Cola di Rienzo.
Conductor Nathalie Stutzmann made a convincing case for an unwieldy composition whose autographed score was given by Wagner’s daughter-in-law, Winifried, to Hitler and lost in the destruction that ended World War II.
The ballet became a hilarious parody of Wagnerian cliches as a cartwheeling child wearing sneakers with rainbow lights and dressed in gold, resembling statues of the composer, presided in front of a faux Bayreuth proscenium. A procession of characters, some in winged helmets, performed silent camp references to Wagner’s renowned roles.

item.title: 莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥和杰夫·贝佐斯领导了耗资 2 亿美元的项目，旨在拯救全球 100 种最受威胁的物种
item.description:
洛杉矶（美联社）——由莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥和杰夫·贝索斯共同资助和创立的基金会发起了一项倡议，承诺投入 2 亿美元来复兴地球上 100 种最受威胁的物种，包括濒临灭绝的狐猴、蝾螈、穿山甲、猪和针鼹。
迪卡普里奥的《Re:wild》和贝索斯地球基金会周二宣布，它们正在领导凤凰物种项目。他们称其为历史上最大的专门致力于恢复极度濒危物种的单一基金。
迪卡普里奥多年来一直致力于共同努力帮助栖息地和未来生存受到气候变化威胁的物种。
2021 年，他和 Re:wild 联合创始人、生物学家韦斯·塞赫雷斯特 (Wes Sechrest) 会见了亚马逊创始人、亿万富翁贝索斯及其妻子、前电视新闻记者兼主持人劳伦·桑切斯·贝索斯 (Lauren Sánchez Bezos)。他担任贝索斯地球基金的主席，她担任副主席。
美联社的丽莎·德怀尔 (Lisa Dwyer) 报道称，两位头条新闻人物联手帮助拯救濒临灭绝的物种。
这次会议引发了与当地政府、环保组织和原住民的一系列对话，讨论如何最好地扭转最脆弱物种的衰退趋势。这些对话最终促成了凤凰物种计划。
该倡议寻求维持的动物包括：
- 金冠狐猴，来自马达加斯加的狐猴
- 山核桃峡谷绿蝾螈，一种无肺树栖动物，仅生活在北卡罗来纳州的一个小峡谷中。
- 米沙鄢疣猪，菲律宾岛屿特有种。
- 墨西哥科苏梅尔收获鼠，仅生活在尤卡坦半岛附近的一个岛屿上。
- 粉红色的陆地鬣蜥，仅在加拉帕戈斯群岛的沃尔夫火山上发现。
- 马来穿山甲，又称巽他穿山甲，原产于东南亚。
- 坦桑尼亚的煎饼龟，因其扁平、柔韧的甲壳而得名。
- 星夜丑角蟾蜍，以其黑白相间的夜空外观而闻名并命名，仅在哥伦比亚山区发现。
- 阿滕伯勒长喙针鼹，一种单孔动物，即产卵哺乳动物，产自新几内亚，为纪念 100 岁的博物学家和自然叙述者大卫·阿滕伯勒而命名。
该项目的目标包括为成功但转瞬即逝的较小努力提供长期支持。
“多年来，我们保护金冠西法卡的预算永远无法与这个物种应有的水平相匹配，但让它灭绝绝不是一个选择，”Fanamby 协会执行董事蒂安娜·安德里亚马纳纳 (Tiana Andriamanana) 在一份声明中表示，该协会是获得该倡议资助的组织之一。“这笔资金、这个全球平台和技术支持改变了一切可能。”

item.title: 爱莉安娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 决定退出公众视野：“不是反应或冲动的事情”
item.description:
纽约（美联社）——在有消息称她将在“永恒阳光”巡演结束后暂时远离公众视线后，她在周一晚上的音乐会上“澄清了一些事情”。
在芝加哥联合中心的舞台上，格兰德告诉她的粉丝，“事情可能会变得有点不成比例”，而她退出公共生活的决定是她“很久以前悄悄做出的”，而不是“反应性或冲动的事情”。
她在手机上继续说道：“这是经过深思熟虑和有权力做出的决定。我想让你知道，很多事情可以同时成为现实。”
周日，斯蒂芬·桑德海姆 (Stephen Sondheim) 的伦敦作品《与乔治一起在公园里的周日》(Sunday in the Park With George) 的制片人宣布，格兰德已退出这部音乐剧中的角色，该音乐剧将于 2027 年在巴比肯剧院首演。
格兰德最近与《邪恶女巫》联合主演伊桑·斯莱特分手，正在进行的巡演以及上周发行的专辑《花瓣》在网上引发了关于她健康和外表的广泛猜测。她此前曾对公众关于她体重的讨论表示不满，并在 2023 年的 TikTok 视频中表示，“我认为无论如何，我们应该更温和、更不舒服地评论人们的身体。”
Grande 的一位代表告诉《人物》杂志，这位 33 岁的歌手“在完成《永恒阳光》巡演后将淡出舞台。”
声明称：“她期待着健康快乐地结束这次巡演，并以高调结束，然后从面向公众的工作和露面中休息一下，这导致了无休止的、持续的公众监督。”
格兰德的代表没有向美联社提供进一步评论。
格兰德周一在台上继续发表讲话，她说她知道粉丝们担心“消极情绪正在毁掉她的一切”，但她表示事实恰恰相反。
“多种事情可以同时发生：需要设定界限，人类有时需要休息，而且，这可以并且将继续是我职业和创意生活中最伟大的经历，”她告诉她的粉丝，粉丝们爆发出欢呼声。
“永恒的阳光”巡演计划于 9 月 1 日在伦敦结束，在著名的 O2 体育场驻留 10 晚。

item.title: 由于卫生官员调查沙门氏菌疫情，Chipotle 从一些餐厅撤下墨西哥辣椒
item.description:
芝加哥（美联社）——Chipotle Mexican Grill 周二表示，在确定辣椒可能与公共卫生官员正在调查的沙门氏菌疫情有关后，该公司已从部分餐厅下架了墨西哥辣椒。
在一份简短的声明中，Chipotle 坚称，“客人和员工的健康和安全是我们的首要任务”，并且出于谨慎考虑，该公司已将墨西哥辣椒撤下，并在之前分发过普通批次的所有地点“用不同种植者的产品取代它们”。
该公司没有具体说明最初的辣椒来自哪里，但指出有问题的墨西哥辣椒被跨多个州发送给多家零售商。
明尼苏达州卫生部周二证实，正在调查与几家墨西哥风味快餐店有关的沙门氏菌疫情，其中墨西哥辣椒是可疑来源。官员们在该州发现了 110 例病例。在能够接触到受影响消费者（他们在 6 月中旬至 7 月中旬期间在这家连锁店就餐）进行采访的大多数消费者中，Chipotle 占了大多数，但并非全部。
明尼苏达州卫生部食源性疾病部门高级流行病学家主管卡洛塔·梅杜斯（Carlota Medus）在一份声明中表示：“根据迄今为止的所有证据，其他餐馆也提供了导致人们生病的食物。”
梅杜斯表示，Chipotle 在调查过程中一直保持合作，考虑到该公司采取的措施，她的部门目前并不担心这家连锁店。不过，她表示“现在判断疫情是否仍在持续还为时过早”，其他地方可能正在供应受污染的食品。
明尼苏达州卫生部指出，其他州正在参与调查，但没有进一步说明。在联邦层面，美国食品和药物管理局正在进行追溯调查，涵盖但不限于墨西哥胡椒。
FDA 周二证实，它于 7 月 22 日启动了“多种成分”的追溯调查，以应对州官员和联邦疾病控制与预防中心发现的一系列沙门氏菌疾病。该机构在一份声明中表示，它感谢 Chipotle 的合作，并表示“如果有可行的公共卫生更新，它将提供更多信息”。
周二下午，疾病预防控制中心没有回应进一步置评的请求。
沙门氏菌中毒的症状包括腹泻、发烧、严重呕吐、脱水和胃痉挛。大多数生病的人会在一周内康复。幼儿、老年人和免疫系统较弱的人的感染可能更为严重，可能需要住院治疗。
Chipotle 在过去几年中一直受到更大规模疫情的打击，特别是在 2015 年至 2018 年期间，一系列大肠杆菌、诺如病毒和食物中毒疾病导致销售额大幅下降。此后，这家总部位于加利福尼亚州的公司一直夸耀自己拥有更严格的食品安全实践。
最近的沙门氏菌疫情爆发正值全国餐馆顾客和餐饮业的艰难时期。一些快餐休闲连锁店仍在努力应对另一场更广泛的环孢菌疫情，该疫情与生菜丝有关，该疫情已导致数千名美国人患病。
Chipotle 尚未与政府对这些环孢子虫疾病的调查联系起来或被提及。尽管如此，该公司还是因疫情爆发而面临销售额下降的公司之一。
Chipotle Mexican Grill 的股价周二暴跌近 10%。
这个故事的前一个版本对 MDH 食源性疾病部门的高级流行病学家主管卡洛塔·梅杜斯 (Carlota Medus) 进行了性别歧视。

item.title: FACT FOCUS: No, you won't need an ID to shop at city-owned grocery stores in New York City
item.description:
纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 计划开设五家市属杂货店的计划在网上被歪曲，帖子声称在那里购物需要身份证明。这些说法与民主党对全国选民身份要求的抵制并列在一起。
共和党官员和其他主要公众人物，以及保守派社交媒体影响者都在发表这一声明。
纽约市经济发展公司临时总裁兼首席执行官珍妮·帕克 (Jeanny Pak) 在上周的新闻发布会上发表评论后，错误信息开始传播。当被问及该市将如何阻止人们在商店享受低价时，帕克提到了“图书馆卡式”系统的可能性。
但市政府官员表示，购物者将不再需要出示身份证件。
声明：在纽约市市营杂货店购物时需要出示身份证件。
事实：这是错误的。据官员称，在该市拥有的商店购物时，不会要求任何人出示身份证件。客户卡类似于传统超市的忠诚储蓄卡，正在讨论作为管理供应并阻止人们转售大量折扣商品的一种方式，但该计划是自愿的，不需要身份证明即可访问。
周一晚上，马姆丹尼在《乔伊·里德秀》节目中对这一说法一笑置之，他说：“当我们谈论一家城市经营的杂货店时，每个行政区都有一家，顺便说一句，无论你刚刚在今天的新闻中听到什么，你都不需要身份证就能在那里购物，我们谈论的是真正解决杂货价格飞涨的问题。”
Mamdani 的发言人 Joe Calvello 和 Dora Pekec 当天晚上也同样驳斥了 X 帖子中的说法。
卡尔韦洛写道：“这甚至需要说出来，但要绝对明确：纽约杂货店将向所有人开放，这真是太疯狂了。”“不会有任何系统来验证身份、居住或收入，也不会要求任何人在购物时出示身份证件。这是我见过的最愚蠢、最虚假的网络新闻周期。”
另一位 Mamdani 发言人卡西奥·门多萨 (Cassio Mendoza) 表示，Pak 在上周的新闻发布会上称之为“图书馆卡式”的系统是一张顾客卡，可以帮助商店管理供应，并防止有抱负的经销商批量购买打折商品。他解释说，获得此类卡不需要身份证明、居住权或收入证明，任何需要的人都可以使用。
在寻求私人杂货店经营者经营城市拥有的商店的提案中，该系统被描述为“一个自愿的免费会员卡计划，用于监控销售活动，并实施折扣计划和任何相关的需求管理措施。”它明确表示，实体进入商店不需要刷卡。
市长办公室的一份声明进一步澄清，“通过市政府采购流程选择的运营商将决定该卡系统的具体设计”，并且“人们不需要通过市政厅或其他政府机构申请。”
网上传播的虚假说法被用来批评选民身份法的反对者，其中许多人是民主党人。特别是，唐纳德·特朗普总统的《拯救美国法案》将要求人们在登记投票之前出示公民身份证明文件，并在全国范围内实施选民身份证件要求。该法案已在美国众议院获得通过，但尚未在参议院获得投票，甚至一些共和党人也表示反对。
市长办公室的声明中写道：“与选民身份法或 SAVE 法案的比较根本不适用。”“这不是一个身份识别系统，也不是一个验证某人是谁、他们住在哪里或他们赚多少钱的机制。”
在这里查找美联社事实核查：https://apnews.com/APFactCheck。

item.title: 水豚在冲撞巴西立法机构时保持冷静
item.description:
巴西库亚巴（美联社）——巴西州议会越来越多地发现其投票会场被一群意想不到的访客入侵：水豚。
这些臭名昭著的寒冷啮齿动物漫步穿过巴西中部马托格罗索州库亚巴当地立法大楼的前门，令上周准备投票的立法者感到惊讶。该建筑毗邻一个充满野生动物的公园。
7月30日，工作人员纳亚拉·布埃诺（Nayara Bueno）拍摄了这种原产于南美洲的啮齿动物的意外来访，并试图带领这些哺乳动物转身返回公园。
“他们经常出现在这里，所以我们已经习惯看到他们了，”布埃诺说。
水豚因其异常冷静的举止和高度社交的天性而在全球网络上人气飙升。作为半水生动物，它们在河流、湖泊和湿地附近繁衍生息，通常群居，体重可达 80 公斤（175 磅）。
他们的访问没有对马托格罗索州立法机构造成任何损害。

item.title: Fatou, the world's oldest gorilla living in captivity, celebrates her 69th birthday at Berlin Zoo
item.description:
柏林（美联社）——世界上最年长的圈养大猩猩法图（Fatou）周一在柏林动物园举办了一场盛宴庆祝她的 69 岁生日，它大口咀嚼圣女果、甜菜、韭菜和生菜。
但没有生日蛋糕，因为糖对衰老的灵长类动物来说不健康。
Fatou 是一只西部低地大猩猩，于 1959 年抵达当时的西柏林。据信她当时大约 2 岁，但具体出生日期不得而知——4 月 13 日是她指定的生日。大猩猩在野外的寿命约为 35-40 年，在圈养条件下的寿命更长。
2024 年，火烈鸟因戈去世后，法图成为动物园最年长的居民。据信这只鸟至少有 75 岁了，自 1955 年以来一直住在动物园里。
美联社的斯蒂芬妮·达齐奥 (Stefanie Dazio) 在德国柏林报道一个特别的生日。
法图很可能出生在西非的野外，但据吉尼斯世界纪录记载，一位法国水手将她带出了非洲，并用她交换了他在法国马赛的酒吧账单。据报道，一名法国动物商人随后将她卖给了动物园。
如今，法图住在自己的围栏里，年老时更喜欢与动物园的其他大猩猩保持距离。她失去了牙齿，还患有关节炎和听力损失。
但柏林动物园的灵长类动物管理员克里斯蒂安·奥斯特表示，她对动物园管理员很友好，尽管仍然有点固执。
69岁的她，这是当之无愧的。Alles Gute zum Geburtstag，Fatou。
